title: The Hooke Folio Online
author: Robert Hooke (Royal Society secretary)
institution: AHRC Centre for Editing Lives and Letters, Queen Mary University of London (Robyn Adams, project leader)
notes: Transcription, beside images, of the Hooke Folio, a manuscript volume of the Royal Society holding extracts from the Journal Books (April 1661 to June 1677) and the rough minutes made while Robert Hooke was secretary (1677-1691), plus supplementary papers and contemporary indexes. The text is on 573 transcribed pages (folios). Word count is ours, from those pages, with the markup removed. Transcriptions were released in September 2007, with corrections and new images in April 2008, and no later project change is recorded. Free for personal use; the Royal Society images and the project's materials are copyright.
